text:
Priya L: New hire running the sample webapp. First request returned a sample reply, subsequent requests 403/billing.required. Walkthrough?
Dan S: Which quickstart (node/curl/python)? Any chance you accidentally used a personal token instead of the workspace key?
Priya L: It's the sample React + server quickstart (curl used by the server). I copied the key shown in the workspace UI.
Priya L: Server curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_workspace_abc' -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-3","input":"ping"}'`
Priya L: First run returned 200 and body with sample text. Next runs returned: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` and body `{\"error\":\"billing.required\",\"message\":\"Workspace API access not enabled\"}`
Leo M: Two possibilities: (1) optimistic UI showed key created before backend activation finished, (2) the key is org-scoped and the workspace-level api_access flag is still false.
sdk-bot: Node SDK behavior: no retry for 4xx, includes HTTP code and error body in thrown error. Does not automatically surface workspace id currently.
Priya L: The console shows key created for "acme-web" and a green toast "API enabled" right after I flipped billing. But the workspace debug JSON still shows `api_access:false` when I open /settings?raw JSON.
infra-bot: Found async job 98001 for workspace acme-web: action=enable_api, started=1769007700, state=failed, reason=payment-provider-429, retries=2.
Dan S: That explains it 52" optimistic confirmation then backend rollback. Quick unblock: billing team can flip api_access=true for the workspace or requeue the job after backoff.
billing-bot: Manual toggle available.
Priya L: If you flip it I can test right away — demo in 25m.
Dan S: Flipped api_access=true for acme-web and forced job retry. Confirmed in billing ledger.
billing-bot: Billing status for acme-web: api_access=true, payment_method=card-set, last_activation=1769008000.
Priya L: Re-ran the quickstart server 52" now 200 on repeated calls. First call was a false positive earlier. :tada:
Leo M: Action items: (1) Quickstart docs: add explicit verification step to call /v1/workspace or show "API access: true" in UI before trusting single request, (2) add a small healthcheck in sample server that fails loudly on 4xx, (3) UI: stop showing green success toast until job completes or show "Activation pending".
sdk-bot: Also proposing SDK improvement: if a 4xx with code "billing.required" is returned, include a small guidance string in the error (e.g., "check workspace billing & api access in Console (UI path)"), and include workspace id if available.
Dan S: Ops follow-up: make activation job use jittered exponential backoff and emit metric when payment-provider-429 > threshold.
Priya L: I'll open a docs PR and attach the console screenshot and the exact error body. Adding a note to the onboarding checklist for new hires to verify API access until UI/ops fixes ship.
Leo M: Thanks everyone. This repeat-fail pattern caused most confusion; healthcheck + clearer UI should cut support pings.
Priya L: Resolved for my demo 52" thanks!
